neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: The t-aspect recipe is lifted to arbitrary families: expand two-piece functional equations, average root-number products, average coefficients, and complete sums. neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Viewing n to the negative it as a character identifies a single L-function along the critical line with a family of twists.
